legalName: Petition for Expungement of Records of Conviction of Certain Felonies (Wyo. Stat. § 7-13-1502)
routeSelectionNote: One route, stated on the petition's own face: a W.S. § 7-13-1502 petition to expunge records of a felony conviction, filed in the convicting court. No election control is rendered. The four eligibility allegations are NOT route elections and are not selected by the build: three of them are listed in the committed record as manual completion items reserved to the participant, counsel or the court, and the fourth (one expungement in a lifetime) turns on a record the platform has not seen.
